label: PF Backlog 574
title: DECISION: define/review the contents of feature groups G1..G10 + their tier membership (currently only titles; not operator-approved)
body: The feature groups G1..G10 and the tier->group membership exist only as short TITLES in core/licensing.py::FEATURE_GROUPS and config/licensing-tiers.json (introduced by BI-0060). There is NO per-feature -> group mapping, and the operator has NOT reviewed/approved this mapping. Decision needed: define what each group contains (which real capabilities/APIs/screens) and confirm the tier->group membership + limits (seats/parallel projects) before it is treated as contractual.
